# jans_sessions_search (Data Source)

Data source for searching active user sessions via the Janssen session search endpoint (GET /jans-auth-server/session/search).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `sessions` (List of Object) List of matching sessions (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sessions))

- `involved_clients_ids` (List of String)
- `jans_id` (String)
- `last_used_at` (String)
- `permission_granted` (Boolean)
- `session_state` (String)
